ScenarioBody.description:
The overlay of one scenario version (Spec 00 §3; ADR 0016).

``reference_level`` is the reference-scenario flag: ``null`` for an ordinary scenario, or
the standardised level it stands for (OQ-16; how reference scenarios are constructed is
open). Disruption scenarios (any severity or closed edge) must state a ``rationing`` case
(OQ-24). ``network_changes`` and ``population_changes`` are placeholders: validated against
the data and recorded on runs, without behaviour yet. Order of application: interventions,
then disruptions (ADR 0016; OQ-30, proposed).
ScenarioBody.title: ScenarioBody

post.description:
Check credentials and set the session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict).

Throttled per username and per client address (ADR 0015): while delayed or locked the answer
is a generic 429 with ``Retry-After``, whether or not the user exists, and the password is
not checked. Failures answer the same 401 for unknown users and wrong passwords.

429.description: Too many failed attempts for this username or client address

post.description: End the session and clear the cookie.
